text:
jonah: Heads up — noticed a weird canary behavior on /v1/generate where users flip between canary and stable on subsequent requests even with sticky enabled. Repro in prod traffic window 09:40-09:50 UTC.

alex: are you seeing cookie churn or header mismatch?

jonah: cookie looks stable. We use x-redwood-rollout header for header-based canary. Some clients send both header+cookie. When header present, routing should win. But logs show route decision toggling: 
```
route_decision: cookie_affinity=canary header_override=stable final=canary
route_decision: cookie_affinity=canary header_override=stable final=stable
```

maria: that suggests non-determinism in tiebreaker. Our code should prefer header_override when present. Which runtime shard handled those requests?

jonah: two different pods (rp-3, rp-7). Same config but different kernel versions. rp-7 had a last-minute patch for sticky session fastpath.

alex: @maria can you pull the decision function? I think we added a fallback that hashes header+cookie when header parsing fails, which could flip bits.

maria: grabbing it now. snippet: 
```
if header_present:
  try: use_header()
  except: use_hash(cookie)
else:
  use_cookie()
```

maria: so if header_present but parsing throws intermittently, we fallback to hash(cookie) and that can pick stable vs canary differently across pods.

jonah: bingo. rp-7's header parser threw on a % encoded char in user-agent; rp-3 didn't throw. Hence different final decision.

sre-pager: impact? number of affected requests?

jonah: about ~1200 requests in that 10m window, ~18% got inconsistent routing, mostly long-poll clients that resend with slightly different UA.

alex: quick mitigation: change fallback to always honor header when present but mark request as partial-fail -> route to header target and emit metric. Rolling patch in canary now.

maria: opened PR with fix + added unit test for malformed header cases. Also adding an integration test in routing-e2e to assert deterministic result across pods.

deploy-bot: rollouts: canary patch rolled to 50% of control plane pods (rp-7 subset). Monitor: routing.inconsistency_count metric emitted. :rocket:

jonah: thanks. follow-up: we should add a console warning when client sends both cookie+header and header parse fails — make it visible in console traces so product can advise clients.

alex: agreed. filing a tiny UX ticket for rollouts console.

maria: noted. I'll add a telemetry tag so traces show "header_parse_error".

jonah: great. closing the loop here — will watch metrics for the hour and re-open if flips persist. :thumbsup:
